name: The Guts!
source: Our hero gets cruelly shot down by the woman he confessed his love for being "unreliable". Motivated to turn his fate around, an ad by Nekoyanagi Construction in urgent need of part-time workers for road work gives him the perfect opportunity to get both the muscles women want and money!
translation: Our hero gets cruelly shot down by the woman he confessed his love for being "unreliable". Motivated to turn his fate around, an ad by Nekoyanagi Construction in urgent need of part-time workers for road work gives him the perfect opportunity to get both the muscles women want and money!
